grid_ignore.reason: A second full-height 400 nm line, drawn as its own path 0.27 pt from the grid's own 400 nm gridline (the grid path holds all the others); the grid's line is used. The two differ by about 1.0 nm.

y.relative_reason: Sensitivity (log) labelled at 1.0 steps; only the two interior gridlines are drawn and the plot frame is not at its labels (2-3 % of a unit off), so the axis is fitted through the two gridlines, which fix the scale. The offset does not reach the profile: D5 rescales every channel.

x.gate_reason: Hand-drafted chart (Professional Film Data Guide; plot about 95 x 85 pt, characteristic curves 140 x 113 pt) whose own gridlines are unevenly spaced by up to 1.6 pt, so no straight axis reproduces them within 0.2 %. Worst gridline 0.31 % of the span (1.04 nm); gate rounded up to the next 0.1 %. The error is bounded by the calibration against spektrafilm's own digitisations of Provia 100F and Velvia 100 and by the charts the guide repeats for other films (docs/adding-film-stocks.md D11).
